definition.en: The International Development Association (IDA) is a member of the World Bank Group that provides interest-free loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries.
definition.hi: The International Development Association (IDA) is a member of the World Bank Group that provides interest-free loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the IDA is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights the mechanisms of international financial assistance and its role in poverty reduction. It is frequently linked to discussions on India's transition from a recipient to a donor and its engagement with global multilateral institutions.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the operational mandate of the IDA within the World Bank Group.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of IDA funding on socio-economic development in low-income nations.
